package.name: morai_v2_1_ros2_msgs
package.description: Hand-authored subset of MORAI SIM's morai_v2_1_ros2_msgs package, containing only the message this stack actually consumes (VehicleManualControl). MORAI does not publish the original message source for this product line (only compiled Windows rosidl typesupport DLLs ship with the simulator), so the field layout here was reconstructed from the Message Template table shown in MORAI's Interface editor: throttle, brake, steering_wheel_angle, all float64/double, in that order. If MORAI ever publishes the real package, replace this one with it.
